subject: Blockchain Inc - Console + API onboarding: scheduling and split-session proposal
messages:
From: John Lee <john.lee@blockchaininc.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.p@blockchaininc.com>
Date: Thu, 8 May 2025 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Console + API onboarding for Blockchain Inc — initial availability

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the quick intro call today. We're ready to get into a hands-on console walkthrough and the API enablement so our engineers can start integrating. High-level ask: a practical session covering (1) Console: environment setup, access patterns, RBAC, and cost controls; (2) API: auth, streaming, and examples for batching and caching.

Attendees from our side: John Lee (Backend Lead) and Maya Patel (SRE). We're on Pacific time. Preferred windows: May 14–15 (morning PT) or May 20 (afternoon PT). Happy to split into two half-days if that helps.

Are you able to propose time slots and session owners?

Thanks —
John

--
John Lee
Backend Lead, Blockchain Inc
john.lee@blockchaininc.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 May 2025 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Console + API onboarding for Blockchain Inc — initial availability

Hi John / Maya —

Great — thanks for the context. We can run a split session model: Day 1 (Console walkthrough + environment prep) and Day 2 (API deep-dive + integration patterns). Proposed slots (PT):
- Option A: May 14, 9:30–12:30 (Console) / May 15, 9:30–12:00 (API)
- Option B: May 20, 13:00–16:00 (Console & API combined, compact)

Ben will lead the API portion and Camila will be the Console session lead. I'll own scheduling and the mutual action plan. I've attached a short agenda draft and a prereqs doc — can you confirm the attendee list and whether you need evening overlap for any APAC teammates?

Attachments: 2025-05-09_onboard-agenda.pdf, sandbox-prereqs.md

Thanks —
Irene
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 May 2025 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Console + API onboarding for Blockchain Inc — initial availability

Thanks Irene — quick operational note from our side: given John's preference for practical examples, I recommend we reserve a small sandbox with sample repo and a pre-populated KV cache so we can demo caching/batching behavior. If we do split days, I'll cover streaming and quantization/latency tips on Day 2.

Proposed micro-schedule (for the split model):
- Day 1 (Console) 9:30–10:15: Access & RBAC, 10:15–11:00: Env setup + keys, 11:00–12:30: Cost controls, runbook and observability
- Day 2 (API) 9:30–10:15: Auth & token handling, 10:15–11:00: Streaming & partial responses, 11:00–12:00: Batching + caching patterns + Q&A

I'll also prepare a mutual-action-plan.xlsx and push to the shared drive. Irene — can you send calendar invites once John's confirmed slots?

Cheers,
Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
